CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
October 8, 2019 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
PROCLAMATION FOR TRISOMY 21 AWARENESS MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim October 2019 as Trisomy 21 Awareness Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Evelyn Acevedo.
6.1 Proclamation
6.2
INTRODUCTION OF NEW-FULL TIME EMPLOYEE - It is recommended the City Council welcome Samantha Couts and present her with a $40.00 gift certificate to Polly's Pie Restaurant, a voucher for two tickets to the La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts, and two passes to Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center.
6.2 Introduction of New City Employee
6.3
RECOGNITION OF EMPLOYEE FOR YEARS OF SERVICE - It is recommended the City Council recognize Eric Garcia for his years of service and present him with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.

APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular meeting of September 24, 2019.

7.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated October 8, 2019 in the total amount of $3,118,743.74.
7.2 Warrant Register - City
7.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING AUGUST 2019 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending August 2019.
7.3 Treasurer Report
7.4
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-09, SLURRY SEALING AND SIGNING AND STRIPING PLANS FOR BIOLA AVENUE, STAGE ROAD, ESCALONA ROAD, FOSTER ROAD, ADELFA DRIVE AND ALICANTE ROAD – REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2018-09, Slurry Sealing and Signing and Striping Plans for Biola Avenue, Stage Road, Escalona Road, Foster Road, Adelfa Drive and Alicante Road, to Roy Allen Slurry Seal, Inc. in the amount of $719,469.45; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction support services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction cost; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project construction cost.
7.4 CIP No. 2018-09
8.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
8.1
RESOLUTION NOS. 19-31, 19-32, and 19-33 REGARDING THE CITY OF LA MIRADA GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION TO BE HELD MARCH 3, 2020 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-31 calling for a General Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, March 3, 2020, for the election of certain officers as required by the provisions of the laws of the State of California relating to General Law cities; adopt Resolution No. 19-32 requesting the Board of Supervisors of the County of Los Angeles to consolidate a General Municipal Election to be held March 3, 2020 with the Statewide Primary Election to be held on the date pursuant to § 10403 of the Elections Code; and adopt Resolution No. 19-33 adopting regulations for candidates and candidate statements.
8.1 Election Resolutions
8.2
RESOLUTION NO. 19-34 AUTHORIZING THE INSTALLATION OF A MULTI-WAY STOP CONTROL AT THE INTERSECTION OF GRANADA AVENUE AT LOS COYOTES AVENUE/MONTICELLO DRIVE AND AUTHORIZING THE SUBMITTAL OF A FUNCTIONAL CLASSIFICATION CHANGE REQUEST TO THE CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION FOR GRANADA AVENUE BETWEEN LA MIRADA BOULEVARD AND STAMY ROAD - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-34 authorizing the installation of a multi-way stop control at the intersection of Granada Avenue at Los Coyotes Avenue/Monticello Drive and authorizing the submittal of a functional classification change request to the California Department of Transportation for Granada Avenue between La Mirada Boulevard and Stamy Road.
8.2 Resolution No. 19-34
